posts.title: The Future of Frontier Labs’ Revenue
posts.description: Revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic has grown wildly. OpenAI grew from $6B to $20B in annualized run-rate revenue over the course of 2025 and reached $24B in March ; Anthropic grew its ARR from $1B to $14B over the same time frame and was at $47B in May . posts.title: An Introduction to Option Theory
